config_name: MacBook Air 13-inch — M5 10-core CPU / 10-core GPU, 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard, Touch ID, Force Touch trackpad

battery.notes: Same 53.8Wh cell; 10-core GPU shaves a little gaming runtime vs 8-core tier.

reviews.quote: It is amazing that you can get this amount of performance in a completely silent laptop.
The Apple MacBook Air 13 (M5, 2026) is a premium ultraportable laptop. It replaces the Apple MacBook Air 13 (M4, 2025) and keeps the same compact, fanless design...
Strong performance and 16GB of RAM minimum... Long battery life... Comfortable keyboard and trackpad.

praises: 10-core GPU tier gives ~20% more gaming/graphics headroom while staying fanless and silent
1TB base storage suits media hoarders — no more cloud-plan tax (Amazon.ca 4.7-star reviews)
Battery still clears a full workday easily even with the faster GPU (RTINGS)
Same superb keyboard and huge trackpad as the Pro line
Fast PCIe 4.0 SSD in every tier; transfers to external drives feel instant (NBC)
complaints: C$450 jump from 512GB base feels steep for the +450GB (common r/macbook pricing gripe)
Soldered everything — you must guess your RAM/storage needs years in advance
60Hz display with notch at this price is a repeated complaint vs OLED Windows rivals
Sustained all-core exports still throttle after minutes due to fanless cooling (NBC)
Two ports total; MagSafe occupies one side of the chassis when charging

design_philosophy: Same silent, fanless Air formula, one step up: the full 10-core GPU plus 1TB suits buyers who edit lightly and keep large libraries local. It keeps the Air's 'everything you need, nothing you don't' stance.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from the directly-tested M5 13-inch base config (NBC 92%, RTINGS 8.3): +0.5 gaming / +0.3 creative for 10-core GPU, −0.1 battery. Image is Apple specs-page CDN jpg. Sentiment from pro-review user-discussion points and Amazon.ca aggregate; Reddit API blocked (403).
